description: Defines a public enumeration 'OpenClawNodeStorage' containing static methods to retrieve URLs for various storage directories such as application support, caches, and canvas snapshots, parameterized by session keys.

methods.name: appSupportDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the application support directory for the app, throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the canvas directory within application support, based on session key.

methods.name: cachesDir
methods.description: Returns the URL to the caches directory for the app, throws an error if unavailable.

methods.name: canvasSnapshotsRoot
methods.description: Returns the URL for the canvas snapshots directory within caches, based on session key.
